results.title: CWG 2026: Gulveer Singh, Harjinder Kaur silver medals add lustre to campaign
results.description: Gulveer Singh won an unprecedented silver for India in the men’s 10,000m in the early hours of Wednesday. He clocked 27:49.78 to finish just behind Australia’s Ky Robinson. Meanwhile, Harjinder Kaur clinched a sensational silver in the women’s 69kg weightlifting event, setting personal bests of 101kg in snatch and 126kg in clean and jerk for a 227kg total. Canada’s Charlotte Simoneau claimed gold with a combined total of 240kg.

results.title: Mariners reinstate Rob Refsnyder from the 10-day IL, DFA Buddy Kennedy
results.description: The Seattle Mariners have reinstated outfielder Rob Refsnyder from the 10-day injured list ahead of a three-game series against the Los Angeles Dodgers.
